cards.ex: I know you're nervous about your presentation, but break a leg!
cards.exUz: Bilaman, taqdimotingizdan xavotirdasiz, lekin omad!
cards.uzDef: Biror ishda omad tilash, ayniqsa spektaklda.

cards.ex: That exam was a piece of cake, I finished in an hour.
cards.exUz: Bu imtihon juda oson edi, men uni bir soatda tugatdim.

cards.ex: I have a huge test next week, so I need to hit the books.
cards.exUz: Keyingi hafta katta testim bor, shuning uchun o'qishga kirishim kerak.

cards.ex: I didn't mean to let the cat out of the bag about their engagement.
cards.exUz: Men ularning unashtiruvi haqidagi sirni ochmoqchi emasdim.

cards.ex: I only go to the cinema once in a blue moon.
cards.exUz: Men kinoga juda kamdan-kam boraman.

cards.ex: That new car costs an arm and a leg!
cards.exUz: Bu yangi mashina juda qimmat turadi!
cards.term: Costs an arm and a leg

cards.ex: I'm feeling a bit under the weather today, so I'm staying home.
cards.exUz: Bugun o'zimni biroz yomon his qilyapman, shuning uchun uyda qolaman.
cards.uzDef: O'zini yaxshi his qilmaslik, kasal bo'lib qolish.

cards.ex: Go on, spill the beans! What happened on your date?
cards.exUz: Ayting-chi! Uchrashuvingizda nima bo'ldi?
cards.uzDef: Sirni yoki maxfiy ma'lumotni oshkor qilish.

cards.ex: I've been burning the midnight oil to finish this project.
cards.exUz: Men ushbu loyihani tugatish uchun kechgacha ishlayapman.
cards.uzDef: Kechgacha yoki tungacha ishlash yoki o'qish.

cards.ex: You hit the nail on the head when you said the problem was communication.
cards.exUz: Muammo aloqada deb aytganingizda, to'g'ri aytdingiz.
cards.term: Hit the nail on the head

cards.ex: He missed the boat on that job opportunity.
cards.exUz: U o'sha ish imkoniyatini o'tkazib yubordi.

cards.ex: We're all in the same boat with these budget cuts.
cards.exUz: Byudjet qisqarishi bilan hammamiz bir ahvoldamiz.
cards.uzDef: Xuddi shu qiyinchilik yoki vaziyatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: Their argument was just a storm in a teacup, they'll be friends again soon.
cards.exUz: Ularning janjali behuda g'alva edi, ular tez orada yana do'stlashadi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik muammo tufayli katta shov-shuv ko'tarish.

cards.ex: You have to take what he says with a grain of salt.
cards.exUz: Uning gaplarini shubha bilan qabul qilishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani to'liq ishonmasdan qabul qilish.

cards.ex: She's been on cloud nine ever since she got engaged.
cards.exUz: U unashtirilganidan beri baxtdan yettinchi osmonda.

cards.ex: You seem distracted. A penny for your thoughts?
cards.exUz: Siz chalg'igan ko'rinasiz. Nima haqda o'ylayapsiz?

cards.ex: Arguing with him will just add fuel to the fire.
cards.exUz: U bilan bahslashish vaziyatni yanada yomonlashtiradi.

cards.ex: The experiment failed, so we're back to square one.
cards.exUz: Tajriba muvaffaqiyatsiz tugadi, shuning uchun biz yana boshidan boshlaymiz.

cards.ex: If you think I took your pen, you're barking up the wrong tree.
cards.exUz: Agar mening qalamingizni olgan deb o'ylasangiz, noto'g'ri yo'ldasiz.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri odamdan yordam so'rash yoki noto'g'ri narsani ayblash.

cards.ex: I hate going to the dentist, but I have to bite the bullet.
cards.exUz: Men tish shifokoriga borishni yomon ko'raman, lekin men chidashim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki yoqimsiz vaziyatga chidashga majbur bo'lish.

cards.ex: I'm tired, let's call it a day.
cards.exUz: Men charchadim, yetar endi.
cards.uzDef: Ishni tugatish, dam olish vaqti keldi.

cards.ex: The company is cutting corners to save money.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya pul tejash uchun sifatni pasaytirmoqda.

cards.ex: I need to get something off my chest; I'm not happy with my job.
cards.exUz: Men dardimni aytishim kerak; Men ishimdan mamnun emasman.

cards.ex: In a nutshell, the project was a success.
cards.exUz: Qisqacha aytganda, loyiha muvaffaqiyatli bo'ldi.

cards.ex: I killed two birds with one stone by doing my shopping on the way to work.
cards.exUz: Ishga ketayotib xarid qilish orqali bir o'q bilan ikki quyonni urdim.
cards.uzDef: Bir harakat bilan ikkita narsaga erishish.

cards.ex: His constant complaining was the last straw, I had to tell him to stop.
cards.exUz: Uning doimiy shikoyatlari sabr kosasini to'ldirgan oxirgi tomchi edi, men unga to'xtashni aytishim kerak edi.

cards.ex: She's really on the ball; she gets everything done quickly.
cards.exUz: U haqiqatan ham epchil; u hamma narsani tezda bajaradi.

cards.ex: Are you serious, or are you just pulling my leg?
cards.exUz: Siz jiddiysizmi yoki shunchaki men bilan hazillashyapsizmi?

cards.ex: They don't always see eye to eye on politics.
cards.exUz: Ular siyosat borasida har doim ham bir fikrda bo'lishmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil fikrda bo'lish, kelishuvga erishish.

cards.ex: You look stressed, you need to take it easy.
cards.exUz: Siz stressda ko'rinasiz, siz osonroq bo'lishingiz kerak.
